title: Vatikin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Berakhot 9b, the Vatikin finish reciting the Shema at sunrise so that they can join the blessing of redemption directly to the Amidah. The same appears in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:2. Rashi explains that they were humble people who cherished the commandments. Hyman suggests that they may have been the Essene sect described at length by Josephus.

notes.text: The possible connection with the Essenes is Hyman’s conjecture, not an established identification.
